تعاطيت (form VI)
# تَعَاطَيْتُ (taʕāṭaytu) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# تَعَاطَيْتَ (taʕāṭayta) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
# تَعَاطَيْتِ (taʕāṭayti) /ta.ʕaː.tˤaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَعَاطَى (taʕāṭā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
